title: Traveller Star System
description: A generated star system produced by traveller_system_gen.py, following the World Builder's Handbook stellar and orbit generation rules. Covers stars, orbits, and a mainworld record.

star_count.description: Total number of stars in the system (primary + all companions and secondaries).

age_gyr.description: System age in gigayears, taken from the primary star. Null when the primary has no defined age (e.g. certain unusual star types).

stars.description: All stars in the system. The primary star is always first (index 0).

orbits.description: Orbit placement data for the entire system.

gas_giant_count.description: Number of gas giant orbit slots placed.

belt_count.description: Number of planetoid belt orbit slots placed.

terrestrial_count.description: Number of terrestrial world orbit slots placed.

total_worlds.description: Total non-empty orbit slots (gas_giant_count + belt_count + terrestrial_count).

empty_orbits.description: Number of empty orbit slots placed (rolled but unoccupied positions).

star_zones.description: Per-star zone boundaries. Keys are star designations (e.g. 'A', 'B', 'Aa').

orbits.description: All orbit slots placed in the system, in ascending orbit-number order per star.

mainworld_orbit.description: The orbit slot that contains the mainworld. Null when the system has no mainworld (e.g. dead-star systems with no surviving worlds).

mainworld.description: The mainworld UWP record. Null when the system has no mainworld.

nhz_atmospheres.description: When true, worlds outside the habitable zone use WBH Non-Habitable Zone atmosphere tables. Pass ?nhz_atmospheres=true to reproduce. Default false.

orbital_eccentricity.description: When true, orbital eccentricity was rolled for all orbiting bodies (WBH p.27). Pass ?orbital_eccentricity=true to reproduce. Default false.

orbital_inclination.description: When true, orbital inclination was rolled for all orbiting bodies (WBH p.28). Pass ?orbital_inclination=true to reproduce. Default false.

runaway_greenhouse.description: When true, the optional runaway greenhouse check (WBH p.79) was applied. Pass ?runaway_greenhouse=true to reproduce. Default false.

independent_government.description: When true, secondary worlds may roll an independent government instead of a captive one (WBH p.162). Default false.

optional_biomass.description: House rule: raises biomass rating from 0 to 1 for oxygenated atmospheres. Pass ?optional_biomass_rule=true to reproduce. Default false.

optional_inhospitable.description: House rule: group biomass roll that can zero out biomass for worlds outside the habitable zone. Default false.

relic_tech.description: House rule: 2D=12 chance of previous-culture relic technology raising a world's Novelty TL. Default false.

settlement_type.description: Settlement-type population DM applied when this system's mainworld population was generated. Default 'standard'.

select_mainworld.description: When true, all terrestrial candidates were scored and the winner may have been promoted to mainworld (WBH pp.155-156). Default false.

social_detail.description: When true, population/government/law/tech detail was attached to every inhabited world. Default false.

unusual_stars.description: When true, the Unusual column (WBH p.219) was used for primary-type determination, allowing neutron stars, black holes, protostars, and environment types. Default false.

_app_version.description: Version string of the traveller-gen package that produced this output. Informational only — do not use as a const constraint.

seed.description: The RNG seed used to generate this system. Present only when a seed was provided. Pass this value together with the generation flags to reproduce identical output.

star_cluster.description: Star Cluster metadata. Present only when the primary star is a Peculiar environment: Star Cluster type (WBH p.219, issue #182).

StarCluster.title: StarCluster
StarCluster.description: Star Cluster metadata for a Peculiar environment: Star Cluster system (WBH p.219). Generated when the primary star is a young Class V star embedded in a star cluster.

age_gyr.description: Cluster age in gigayears (1D × 1D × 50 Myr, max 1.80 Gyr).

single_hex.description: True when the cluster fits within a single subsector hex (1D roll 1-3). False for multi-hex clusters.

hex_diameter.description: Diameter of the cluster in subsector hexes. 1 for single-hex clusters; 1D+1 (2-7) for multi-hex clusters.

system_count.description: Number of star systems in the centre hex of the cluster (2D+5). Outer hexes contain fewer systems (DM-2).

merged_star.description: True when the primary star's main-sequence lifespan is shorter than the cluster age, indicating the star has evolved off the main sequence.

jump_restriction.description: Jump navigation restriction for the cluster. 'Jump-2 minimum' for multi-hex clusters; empty string for single-hex clusters.

Star.title: Star
Star.description: One star in the system, including physical properties, orbital parameters, and designation.

designation.description: Star designation: 'A' for the primary; 'Aa'/'Ab' for companions; 'B', 'C' for secondaries.

role.description: Stellar role. 'primary' = the most massive star; 'companion' = co-orbital with parent; 'close'/'near'/'far' = secondary stars at those WBH separation bands.

classification.description: Full spectral classification string (e.g. 'G2 V', 'M5 VI', 'NS', 'BH'). For compact remnants the spectral_type is returned directly.

spectral_type.description: Spectral letter. Standard main-sequence/giant types (O–M); D = white dwarf; BD = brown dwarf; NS = neutron star; PSR = pulsar; BH = black hole.

subtype.description: Decimal subtype (0–9). Null for compact remnants (NS, PSR, BH, D, BD) which have no subtype.

luminosity_class.description: Luminosity class. Standard MK classes (Ia–VI); BD/D/NS/PSR/BH match spectral_type for compact objects.

temperature_k.description: Effective surface temperature in Kelvin. 0 for black holes (no surface emission).

orbit_number.description: WBH Orbit# of this star around the primary (or its parent, for companions). Null for the primary star itself.

orbit_au.description: Mean orbital distance in AU. Null for the primary star.

age_gyr.description: Star age in gigayears. All stars in a system share the primary's age. Null for protostar or certain environment types.

ms_lifespan_gyr.description: Main-sequence lifespan in Gyr. Null for compact remnants with no defined MS lifespan.

orbit_period_yr.description: Orbital period in years (Kepler's third law). Null for the primary and for companion stars (period = parent's period).

colour.description: Display colour name for this star's spectral type (e.g. 'Yellow-White', 'Red', 'Blue-White').

name.description: Optional star name assigned by attach_body_names(). Empty string when no name has been assigned.

special_notes.description: Free-text notes added during generation, e.g. 'Protostar', 'Peculiar environment: Nebula'. Empty string for ordinary stars.

orbit_eccentricity.description: Orbital eccentricity (0 = circular). Only present when orbital_eccentricity=true was requested and the value is > 0.

orbit_au_min.description: Periapsis distance in AU: orbit_au × (1 − orbit_eccentricity). Present only when orbit_eccentricity is present.

orbit_au_max.description: Apoapsis distance in AU: orbit_au × (1 + orbit_eccentricity). Present only when orbit_eccentricity is present.

orbit_inclination.description: Orbital inclination in degrees. Only present when orbital_inclination=true was requested and the value is > 0. Values above 90° indicate retrograde motion.

bh_schwarzschild_km.description: Schwarzschild radius in km. Only present when spectral_type is 'BH'.

StarZone.title: StarZone
StarZone.description: Orbital zone boundaries for one star in the system.

mao.description: Minimum Allowable Orbit number (Orbit#) for this star (WBH p.37).

hzco.description: Habitable Zone Centre Orbit number (WBH p.38). The orbit# of the ideal habitable zone.

hz_inner.description: Inner habitable zone boundary (Orbit#). hz_deviation < 0 here is 'cold' territory.

hz_outer.description: Outer habitable zone boundary (Orbit#). hz_deviation > 0 here is 'hot' territory.

OrbitSlot.title: OrbitSlot
OrbitSlot.description: One orbit slot placed by generate_orbits(). May be empty, a belt, a gas giant, a terrestrial world, or a stellar body.

star.description: Designation of the star this orbit belongs to (e.g. 'A', 'B', 'Aa').

orbit_number.description: WBH Orbit# coordinate for this slot.

orbit_au.description: Mean orbital distance in AU, derived from orbit_number.

slot_index.description: Sequential index of this slot within the star's orbit sequence (continuous across inner and outer zones). Anomalous orbit slots may receive index 0.

world_type.description: Type of body occupying this orbit slot. 'star' is used for secondary-star orbit placeholders.

is_habitable_zone.description: True when this orbit falls within the star's habitable zone (inner ≤ orbit# ≤ outer).

hz_deviation.description: Signed deviation from the habitable zone centre (Orbit# units). Negative = closer to star than HZ centre; positive = farther.

temperature_zone.description: Temperature zone derived from hz_deviation using the WBH HZ Regions table.

is_mainworld_candidate.description: True when this terrestrial slot was considered as a mainworld candidate during select_mainworld scoring.

notes.description: Human-readable notes for this orbit slot (e.g. anomaly type, orbital parameters). Empty string when no notes apply.

canonical_profile.description: When set, the canonical UWP profile from TravellerMap data. Present only for TravellerMap-sourced worlds.

gg_sah.description: Gas giant SAH code rolled at orbit-generation time (e.g. 'GM9', 'GL3'). Category: GS = Small, GM = Medium, GL = Large; final character is an extended-hex diameter digit. Present only for gas_giant slots.

gg_mass_earth.description: Gas giant mass in Earth masses. Rolled at orbit-generation time. Present only for gas_giant slots that have been fully processed.

anomaly_type.description: Anomalous orbit type (WBH pp.49-50). Present only for anomalous orbit slots.

orbit_period_yr.description: Orbital period in years (Kepler's third law). Present when orbital data is sufficient to compute it.

eccentricity.description: Orbital eccentricity. Present only when orbital_eccentricity=true was requested and the value is > 0.

orbit_au_min.description: Periapsis distance in AU: orbit_au × (1 − eccentricity). Present only when eccentricity is present.

orbit_au_max.description: Apoapsis distance in AU: orbit_au × (1 + eccentricity). Present only when eccentricity is present.

inclination.description: Orbital inclination in degrees. Present only when orbital_inclination=true was requested and the value is > 0.

name.description: Body name assigned by attach_body_names(). Present only when a name has been assigned.

radiation_zone.description: True when this orbit is within a pulsar's lethal radiation zone (PSR/magnetar systems). Absent when false.

detail.description: Secondary world or satellite detail record. Present only after attach_detail() has been called and the slot holds a non-gas-giant world.
